reason: The reported north-only estimate reproduces (0.09, p=0.82), but the north restriction is unjustified. On the full sample (N=2000) with the same pre-period controls, training_hours has a positive, significant effect of about 0.59–0.61 (p≈0.01), and the south subsample is also significant (0.97, p=0.01). The north estimate is too imprecise (SE≈0.4) to rule out the full-sample effect, so 'no effect' is an absence-of-evidence claim drawn from a cherry-picked subgroup.
